The '''''Gizer Gut''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] to smuggle [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights [[Bazel Warv]], [[Seff Hellin]], [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], and [[Natua Wan]] to [[Shedu Maad]] before they could be captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces and encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].
